tenants.reason: Platform tenant directory and lifecycle control plane.

users.reason: Global login identity; staff tenancy is represented by memberships.

tenant_memberships.reason: Membership always belongs to exactly one enterprise tenant.

tenant_membership_roles.reason: Tenant role assignment inherits its membership tenant.

tenant_membership_data_scopes.reason: Data scope assignment inherits its membership tenant.

platform_user_roles.reason: Platform role assignment exists outside tenant business scope.

platform_audit_logs.reason: Immutable platform control-plane audit records are governed outside enterprise business scope.

platform_ai_capability_versions.reason: Immutable versions of platform-wide AI capabilities.

platform_ai_config_audit_logs.reason: Platform control-plane AI configuration audit history.

platform_plans.reason: Platform-wide commercial plan catalogue shared by all tenants.

platform_plan_versions.reason: Immutable platform-wide plan versions are reusable across tenants.

platform_plan_entitlements.reason: Entitlements belong to a global plan version rather than one tenant.

tenant_subscriptions.reason: Every subscription binds one tenant to a published plan version.

tenant_entitlement_overrides.reason: Every entitlement override applies to exactly one tenant.

tenant_usage_snapshots.reason: Every usage snapshot measures exactly one tenant's consumption.

platform_quota_alerts.reason: Every quota alert is raised for exactly one tenant.

tenant_invitations.reason: Staff invitation always targets exactly one tenant.

refresh_tokens.reason: Candidate and platform sessions are global; staff sessions bind an active tenant.

jobs.reason: Every job is owned by one recruiting tenant.

candidate_profiles.reason: Candidate-owned profile reused across applications to different tenants.

candidate_educations.reason: Candidate-owned education history reused across applications to different tenants.

candidate_experiences.reason: Candidate-owned work history reused across applications to different tenants.

resumes.reason: Candidate-owned source resume reused across tenants.

resume_parse_runs.reason: Parsing is attached to a candidate-owned source resume.

resume_profiles.reason: Structured profile is derived from a candidate-owned source resume.

resume_educations.reason: Child of a global candidate resume profile.

resume_experiences.reason: Child of a global candidate resume profile.

resume_projects.reason: Child of a global candidate resume profile.

resume_skills.reason: Child of a global candidate resume profile.

applications.reason: Tenant is derived from the target job at application creation.

application_status_transitions.reason: Child audit history of a tenant application.

ai_chat_sessions.reason: Candidate sessions are global while staff sessions are tenant-bound.

ai_chat_history.reason: Inherits the scope of its chat session.

ai_session_summaries.reason: Inherits the scope of its chat session.

ai_tool_traces.reason: Candidate traces are global while staff traces are tenant-bound.

agent_runs.reason: Run scope follows the initiating candidate or staff session.

agent_run_events.reason: Inherits the scope of its agent run.

agent_run_steps.reason: Inherits the scope of its agent run.

candidate_match_evaluations.reason: Evaluation is performed against a tenant-owned job and application.

candidate_match_evidence.reason: Child evidence of a tenant match evaluation.

ai_memories.reason: Candidate memory is global; staff memory is tenant-bound.

ai_embeddings.reason: Retrieval scope must distinguish global candidate and tenant staff data.

notifications.reason: Platform/global notifications coexist with tenant business notifications.

event_outbox.reason: Domain events may be global or tenant-bound.

email_logs.reason: Platform/global mail coexists with tenant business mail.

event_inbox.reason: Consumed events retain the scope of their source event.

analytics_projection_events.reason: Projection inputs may be global or tenant-bound.

analytics_projection_checkpoints.reason: Operational cursor for a projection consumer, not tenant business data.

invite_codes.reason: Legacy staff invitations must be bound to one tenant.

third_party_usage_logs.reason: Candidate/platform usage may be global; staff usage is tenant-bound.

utc8_time_conversion_audit.reason: Platform migration evidence contains table cells but no tenant business ownership.

billing_products.reason: Global commercial catalogue for tenant and candidate products.

billing_price_versions.reason: Immutable global price and entitlement snapshots.

billing_subscriptions.reason: A subscription is owned by either one tenant or one candidate user.

billing_orders.reason: An order is owned by either one tenant or one candidate user.

billing_payments.reason: Payment scope follows the owning tenant or candidate order.

billing_refunds.reason: Refund scope follows the owning tenant or candidate order.

billing_webhook_events.reason: Payment-channel callback inbox is platform infrastructure and resolved to orders during processing.

ai_rate_cards.reason: Platform-wide immutable AI supplier cost catalogue.

ai_usage_events.reason: Candidate AI usage is user-owned while staff AI usage is tenant-owned.

ai_credit_grants.reason: Credit buckets belong to either one tenant or one candidate user.

ai_credit_reservations.reason: Reservations belong to either one tenant or one candidate user.

ai_credit_ledger.reason: Ledger entries belong to either one tenant or one candidate user.

ai_billing_settlement_outbox.reason: Settlement delivery follows the tenant or candidate owner of its Billing reservation.

roles.reason: Global role catalog with an explicit identity, tenant, or platform scope type.

permissions.reason: Canonical permission catalog shared by all tenants.

role_permissions.reason: Canonical mapping between global role and permission catalogs.

user_roles.reason: Compatibility store for identity-scoped roles; tenant roles move to memberships.

user_data_scopes.reason: Compatibility store during migration; staff scopes move to memberships.

authorization_audit_logs.reason: Platform/global decisions coexist with tenant authorization decisions.

interview_schedules.reason: Interview inherits the tenant of its application.

interview_feedback.reason: Feedback inherits the tenant of its interview.

offers.reason: Offer inherits the tenant of its application.

offer_events.reason: Offer event inherits the tenant of its offer.

job_locations.reason: Enterprise recruiting location taxonomy is tenant-owned.

candidate_notes.reason: Internal recruiting note belongs to one tenant.

candidate_tags.reason: Candidate collaboration taxonomy belongs to one tenant.

candidate_tag_assignments.reason: Tag assignment belongs to one tenant candidate workspace.

follow_up_tasks.reason: Recruiting collaboration task belongs to one tenant.

ai_usage_auth_contexts.reason: Authorization context follows global candidate or tenant staff usage.

llm_providers.reason: Platform-managed providers coexist with tenant BYOK providers.

llm_models.reason: Model configuration inherits platform or tenant provider scope.

llm_model_catalog.reason: Verified reusable model metadata catalog is platform-wide.

llm_model_metadata_observations.reason: Evidence for the platform-wide model catalog.

embedding_providers.reason: Platform-managed and tenant BYOK embedding providers coexist.

prompt_templates.reason: Platform templates coexist with tenant overrides.

prompt_versions.reason: Inherits the scope of its prompt template.

agent_configs.reason: Platform agent templates coexist with tenant agent configurations.

agent_tool_bindings.reason: Inherits the scope of its agent configuration.

mcp_servers.reason: Platform tools coexist with tenant tool connections.

mcp_tool_logs.reason: Tool execution log inherits the invoking principal scope.

mcp_tool_policies.reason: Platform policies coexist with tenant policy overrides.

agent_capability_bindings.reason: Inherits the scope of the owning agent configuration.

agent_skills.reason: Platform agent skills coexist with tenant customizations.

agent_skill_versions.reason: Inherits the scope of its agent skill.
